messages:
erin: follow-up on the dedicated shard-pool idea. want to finalize operator boundaries before RFC freeze
devon: ok. main risk: guaranteeing fast-path p99 while avoiding starvation of steady tenants
erin: plan = per-pool two lanes: fast-path (prewarmed, low packing) + steady-path (dense packing). operator controls lane sizing
kai: promote/demote oscillation is my worry
erin: add sustain_window_s and cooldown; only promote when util>0.8 for sustain_window_s and move bounded chunk (configurable min_percent & max_abs)
tessa: suggest default chunk = min(10% , 2 GPUs). tenant SLA overrides allowed but capped by contract
devon: billing implications? who pays for carved fast-path capacity
erin: baseline reservation billed normally. transient use logged to burst_ledger rows (tenant, gpus, start, end, preemptible) and metered
kai: eviction order must be explicit to avoid evicting high-SLA tenants for bursts
erin: eviction priority: pinned -> gold SLA -> silver -> burst_credit -> preemptible
tessa: fairness across time? frequent bursters could game it
erin: implement burst_score with decay (half-life ~1h) to deprioritize heavy recent users
devon: controller topology: operator-per-shard plus lightweight global reconciler (leader elected) to enforce pool caps
kai: KV cache warming when promoting live instances could spike latency
erin: operator prefers cold allocations into fast-path first; live demotion only for low-util instances or where KV sync is available
orch-bot: deploy-planner: creating canary plan for us-west-2 (10% pools, 48h). will add preflight checks
tessa: metrics to watch: fast_path_util, p99_by_SLA, promotion_count, eviction_events, burst_ledger_debits
erin: add ledger retention = 180d default; compress older events after 30d
devon: test plan: unit admission tests, k8s-integration for operator behavior, chaos tests for leader failover
erin: i'll draft the follow-up RFC tonight and share the config schema + rollout checklist
tessa: tiny nit: rename promotion_window_s -> sustain_window_s to clarify intent
erin: updated in draft. syncing tomorrow 10am PT to finalize thresholds
erin: thanks all :thumbsup:
